statements.status_notes: The fixed release is Next.js 16.3.3 on the 16.x line (15.5.24 on 14.x). Langfuse v2 remains on Next.js 14.2.35; v3/v4 need an upstream Next.js bump that could not be validated here.

The advisory fix requires Next.js 16.3.3 or newer on the 16.x line. Langfuse v3 and v4 ship upstream-pinned Next.js releases; bumping Next.js in the build override failed validation in this environment (v3 EMFILE, v4 OOM) and needs a dedicated upstream-aligned upgrade.

Langfuse 2.x is end-of-life upstream (last release v2.95.12 on 2025-11-18; no further releases). Next.js is bumped to 14.2.35 (latest 14.x); the upstream fix only exists in the 15.x major line which DHI v2 cannot adopt without breaking compatibility with the langfuse 2.x bundle. Customers requiring active CVE remediation should adopt the langfuse 3.x DHI variant (Next 16); this v2 image is published for migration compatibility only.
